  `cast` = 'Alaqua Cox as Maya Lopez / Echo, Vincent D''Onofrio as Wilson Fisk / Kingpin, Chaske Spencer as Skully, Tantoo Cardinal as Chula, Devery Jacobs as Bonnie, Graham Greene as Uncle Henry, Zahn McClarnon as William Lopez',
  tagline = 'Her story. Her power. Marvel''s first Indigenous-led series breaks new ground.',
  description = 'Echo follows Maya Lopez as she returns to her hometown in Oklahoma after breaking away from Kingpin, reconnecting with her Native American heritage and discovering powers linked to her Choctaw ancestry while Fisk pursues her.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/echo-featured-jJTGdqJqNQxTvPLxjjNSKt.webp',

  cardMarketContent = '## Echo Cards: Indigenous Representation in Marvel Cards\n\nEcho cards are significant as the first MCU cards featuring an Indigenous-led story. The show''s connection to Kingpin and Daredevil gives certain cards crossover appeal. Alaqua Cox''s Maya Lopez cards have speculative value as the character may return in future Daredevil projects.',
  keyCards = '- **2024 Upper Deck Echo Maya Lopez** — First Indigenous MCU lead card, $5-12\n- **2024 Upper Deck Echo Kingpin** — Vincent D''Onofrio continued, $5-15\n- **2024 Upper Deck Echo Choctaw Heritage Cards** — Culturally significant artwork, $3-8',
  content = '## Marvel''s First Indigenous-Led Series\n\nEcho made history as Marvel''s first series led by an Indigenous character, with a predominantly Indigenous cast and creative team. The show''s exploration of Choctaw heritage and Maya''s connection to her ancestors through supernatural powers brought genuine cultural specificity to the MCU.\n\n## The Kingpin Connection\n\nVincent D''Onofrio''s Kingpin continued his journey from Netflix through Hawkeye to Echo, with the show revealing more of his relationship with Maya and setting up his political ambitions that would carry into Daredevil: Born Again.\n\n## The Marvel Spotlight Experiment\n\nEcho was released under the "Marvel Spotlight" banner, indicating it was more standalone and didn''t require extensive MCU knowledge. This experiment in accessibility was Marvel''s attempt to make individual shows feel less homework-dependent.\n\n## Fun Facts\n\n- The show was the first to be released under the Marvel Spotlight banner\n- Alaqua Cox is deaf in real life, as is her character Maya Lopez\n- The show was released all episodes at once rather than weekly\n- Choctaw cultural advisors were consulted throughout production\n- The show''s powers connect Maya to her ancestors across generations',
  metaDescription = 'Echo (2024) guide — Maya Lopez story, Indigenous representation, Kingpin connection, trading card values, and Marvel Spotlight explained.',
  keywords = 'echo, maya lopez, alaqua cox, kingpin, indigenous, choctaw, disney plus marvel, marvel spotlight, marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Echo Maya Lopez cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Do I need to watch Hawkeye before Echo?","answer":"Yes, Echo''s character was introduced in Hawkeye and her relationship with Kingpin is established there. The show picks up after those events."},{"question":"What is Marvel Spotlight?","answer":"Marvel Spotlight is a banner for shows that are more standalone and don''t require extensive MCU knowledge to enjoy, though they still exist within the MCU continuity."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'echo-2024';
